results.snippet:
The retaking of Mali’s northern desert town of Kidal from Tuareg separatists and al-Qaeda-linked Jama’at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM) represents a moderate gain for the Malian government, but one with limited strategic value.
